Class NumberFieldBuilder

java.lang.Object
au.ellie.hyui.builders.UIElementBuilder<NumberFieldBuilder>
au.ellie.hyui.builders.NumberFieldBuilder
All Implemented Interfaces:
BackgroundSupported<NumberFieldBuilder>
public class NumberFieldBuilder extends UIElementBuilder<NumberFieldBuilder>
A builder class for constructing a number input field UI element. This class extends the UIElementBuilder to provide functionality specific to creating and customizing number input fields. The NumberFieldBuilder supports setting the initial numeric value, attaching event listeners, and integrating with specific themes and styles. It facilitates the seamless generation of commands and events during the UI build phase.

    • addEventListener

      public NumberFieldBuilder addEventListener(com.hypixel.hytale.protocol.packets.interface_.CustomUIEventBindingType type, Consumer<Double> callback)
      Adds an event listener to the number field builder. The only type it accepts will be ValueChanged.
      Parameters:
      type - the type of the event to listen for, represented by CustomUIEventBindingType. This defines the specific event binding, such as ValueChanged.
      callback - the function to execute when the specified event occurs. The callback receives a Double value, which typically represents the current numeric value associated with the event.
      Returns:
      the current instance of NumberFieldBuilder, enabling method chaining.
